svg.title: AI & LLM Threat Frameworks & Risk Management Architecture
svg.desc: AI & LLM Threat Frameworks diagram showing NIST AI RMF 1.0 functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage), OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and MITRE ATLAS matrix mapping.
svg.text: AI & LLM Threat Frameworks & Risk Management
NIST AI RMF 1.0 risk functions, OWASP Top 10 LLM risks (2025), and MITRE ATLAS adversarial ML threat mapping.
• GOVERN: Organizational culture, policy, risk tolerance & accountability
• MAP: Context identification, capability capabilities & AI system scoping
• MEASURE & MANAGE: Empirical testing, quantitative scoring & risk response
• LLM01: Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect RAG Poisoning)
• LLM02: Sensitive Information Disclosure → LLM06: Excessive Agency
• LLM04: Model DoS → LLM05: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
MITRE ATLAS (ADVERSARIAL THREAT LANDSCAPE FOR AI SYSTEMS)
Empirical AI TTP Matrix & Attack Lifecycle
• Reconnaissance & ML Resource Access → Initial Access (Model Supply Chain / RAG Poisoning)
• Execution & Persistence (Prompt Injection / Agent Hijacking) → Exfiltration (Model Inversion / Data Leakage)
• Impact: Data Poisoning, Model Evasion, System Hijacking, and Resource Exhaustion
AI RISK ALIGNMENT: NIST GOVERNANCE → OWASP RISK IDENTIFICATION → MITRE ATLAS TTP MAPPING → GUARDRAIL CONTROL ENFORCEMENT
